name: badge
title: Badge
description: A count or an unread dot next to a label or on an icon.

when: Showing how many items need attention.

instead.when: The status is a word, not a number.

guidance.rule: Use `danger` only for counts that need action now.

builtIn: On an icon the badge is hidden; the control's label must say the count.
youProvide: The count in the control's accessible name when the badge sits on an icon.

genui.description: A numeric count next to a label. Use lozenge for status words.
